headline: Reddit restricts RSS, API and Old Reddit access over AI bots
summary: Reddit is ending RSS feed support and public API access, and further restricting the 'Old Reddit' experience, citing efforts to combat scraping and automated traffic from AI bots. Within the next few months, users will need to be logged in to use Old Reddit.
